title: ELP advises Centre for Sight on acquisition of The Eye Clinic, Dehradun
description: New Delhi Centre for Sight Limited has acquired The Eye Clinic, Dehradun.Economic Laws Practice advised New Delhi Centre for Sight on this acquisition. The Firm advised on the transaction structure and on the drafting, negotiation, and finalisation of all the relevant transaction documents.The transaction team consisted of Abhishek Sanyal (Partner), Jishnu Dhar (Associate Partner), Simran Yadav (Senior Associate) and Kingshuk Saha (Senior Associate).If you would like your Deals, Columns, Press R
